messages:
alex: Heads up — seeing a 2.3x latency spike on prod causal generation for model=redwood-repro-7b where head_dim==20. Traced kernel-picker logs to a flashv3 causal slowpath pick that used the slow kernel. Repro + logs below.

alex: kernel-picker log snippet:
```
kernel-picker: chosen=flashv3_causal_slowpath reason=headdim_unaligned(20) seq_len=1024 sm=90 probe_score=0.62
kernel-picker: candidate=flashv2_noncausal_fast estimated=11.9ms reason=not_compatible_causal
```

maria: Can you paste the exact microbench numbers and the command you ran to reproduce?

alex: Repro command (run on an SM90 test node):
```
env KERNEL_PICKER_DEBUG=1 ./bench_infer --model re7b --seq 1024 --heads 32 --head-dim 20 --causal=true --batch 1
```

alex: Microbench results (single-run medians):
- flashv3_causal_slowpath: 27.8 ms/token
- flashv2_noncausal_fast (if forced): 11.9 ms/token
- historical baseline (before autotune change): ~12.1 ms/token

cheng: We merged an autotuner tweak 48h ago that relaxed alignment gating for SM90. It changed the headmod heuristic and the hysteresis on kernel flips. Might have unintentionally expanded the slowpath region for small odd head dims like 20.

cheng: Current heuristic (pseudocode):
```
if sm >= 90:
  if head_dim % 8 != 0 and seq_len > 512:
    prefer = flashv3_causal_slowpath
  else:
    prefer = flashv2
```

cheng: The bug is subtle: the autotuner now treats head_dim%8!=0 as a stronger signal than the measured probe_score. So for head_dim=20 it picks slowpath even though measured latency favors flashv2 for our seq_len range.

perf-bot: Alert posted: perf-regression 2571234567 -> https://perf.redwood/runtime/dashboard?run=2571234567 (CI flagged +35% latency on causal generation for re7b head_dim=20).

maria: Immediate ask: can we push a prod override to force flashv2 for this shard and open a canary rollback of the autotune flag? Also add a unit/regression test for head_dim=20 so CI catches this.

cheng: I can run a microbench sweep across SM80/SM90 and seq_len [128,512,1024,2048] and attach flamegraphs. Quick mitigation: runtime supports a dynamic override. Example override (applied to canary):
```
KERNEL_PICKER_OVERRIDES={"flashv3_causal_slowpath": {"enabled": false}}
```

alex: Applied the override to canary pool and re-ran the same bench: flash latency dropped back to ~12.0 ms/token. Canary traces look good.

maria: Great. Schedule a rollback of the autotuner flag in the next 30m if canary remains stable. Also add a note in the release changelog that autotune headmod changes are gated behind a feature flag. :white_check_mark:

cheng: I'll open a PR with two changes: 1) tighten the headmod threshold (prefer flashv2 for head_dim < 24 when seq_len>512 on SM90), 2) add an integration test that exercises head_dim in {16,20,24,28} for causal/non-causal paths. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12345 (WIP).

alex: Leaving a TODO to add a small end-to-end sanity check to perf CI that runs head_dim=20 for the critical models. If CI warns, block autotune merge.

maria: Thanks all. Quick followups: attach flamegraphs and include the kernel-picker probe output in the PR so reviewers can see the scoring change.

cheng: Will post the flamegraphs and the SM80 vs SM90 breakdown in this thread when done. :mag: :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: Reaction: :eyes:

maria: Reaction: :thumbsup:
